svg.title: Air quality technician — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as air quality technician, wearing a work jacket. Visible work cue: An air-sampling unit has a tall inlet mast and round indicator beside a separate two-stage filter cartridge. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a softly squared face.
